name: Mekurumeku Buai no Utage
source:
Chika Osanai is a 28 year old woman who has been happily married for the past 2 years. She met her husband when they both were studying to become junior high school teachers at the university. Since her husband was six year her senior he graduated before Chika could finish her studies and they moved to the city where he got a job and she became a housewife. With their savings they have now moved into an apartment in a high-rise building.

Chika befriending the neighboring woman Mariko who, like Chika is also a housewife. Mariko Kurihara is 33 years old and her husband is rarely home since he is an airplane captain and do a lot of travel. All seems calm and quiet in the new building until one day when Chika is over for tea at Mariko’s apartment and there is a sudden ring at the door. In comes and handsome young man who introduces himself as Miura. The next moment he orders Mariko to kiss him and Chika is suddenly witnessing an act of infidelity for the first time. At first she is distraught be the scene, but as time goes on she finds herself more and more drawn to the experience. Then one day when Chika is going around town doing some shopping she sees Miura and an unexpected fire begins to burn inside her. She tries to convince herself it is all a dream, but things soon become very real.

[From EroEroReview]
translation:
小山内千佳28岁，已经幸福结婚两年。她与丈夫在大学相识，当时两人都在学习成为初中教师。丈夫比千佳大六岁，先一步毕业。两人搬到丈夫就职的城市，千佳则成为家庭主妇。如今，他们用积蓄搬进一栋高层公寓。

千佳与邻居栗原真理子成为朋友，对方同样是家庭主妇。真理子33岁，丈夫担任机长，经常出差，很少在家。新公寓里的生活看似宁静安稳，直到某天，千佳到真理子家喝茶，门铃突然响起。一个自称三浦的英俊青年走进来，下一刻便命令真理子亲吻自己。千佳生平第一次亲眼目睹出轨。

她起初被眼前一幕弄得心烦意乱，随着时间流逝，却发现自己越来越受这种体验吸引。后来某天，千佳上街购物时看见三浦，一团意想不到的火焰在心中燃起。她努力说服自己这一切只是梦，事情却很快变得无比真实。

[译自EroEroReview]
